scope: CPU-only audit; no fit/search dispatched, no source/config mutation, no test rerun

estimate_method.fit: Published H200 cold + seven times published warm median; an estimate because individual repeats are absent. Excludes file reads, serialization, process startup, and CUDA context. Not a local fit measurement.
estimate_method.search: Published legacy search operation counts divided by measured proxy operations/second of prior local 10k development searches. Workload projection only; model connectivity, long-tail behavior, recreated data, and compilation can change elapsed time. No inference was run for these estimates.

disk.reserve_description: Uncompressed train payload + models + observed JSON size scaled with 2x headroom + two max-size checkpoint copies for each of 3 lanes. Compression/header/runtime variations are not an exact storage prediction.

queue_optimization.change: Wait for child exit with 15-second progress timeout, replacing unconditional 15-second sleeps; failure handling and dispatch order unchanged.
queue_optimization.not_elapsed_speedup_measurement: The upper bound/expectation refer only to avoided queue sleep, not inference speedup.

gpu_lane_coordination: All additional lanes remain controlled by root; no MPS adoption or new GPU jobs. Figure4 MPS gain does not establish a data-efficiency benefit.
